Login Search After-Hours Earnings Report for February 1, 2018 : AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, V, AMGN, EW, MSI, EMN, FBHS, XL, CPT, AIV February 01, 2018, 02:00:03 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo 
The following companies are expected to report earnings after hours on 02/01/2018. Visit our Earnings Calendar for a full list of expected earnings releases. 
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) is reporting for the quarter ending December 31, 2017. The computer company's consensus earnings per share forecast from the 9 analysts that follow the stock is $3.82. This value represents a 13.69% increase compared to the same quarter last year. In the past year AAPL has beat the expectations every quarter. The highest one was in the 3rd calendar quarter where they beat the consensus by 10.7%. Zacks Investment Research reports that the 2018 Price to Earnings ratio for AAPL is 15.04 vs. an industry ratio of 2.80, implying that they will have a higher earnings growth than their competitors in the same industry.
